Egg White Breakfast Muffins
Yield: 12 muffins (6 servings of 2)

Ingredients
12 large eggs
2 cups (480 ml) liquid egg whites
1 cup chopped spinach
1/2 cup diced red bell pepper
4 oz turkey sausage, cooked and crumbled
1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
1/4 tsp black pepper
Cooking spray

Instructions
Preheat oven to 350°F and spray a 12-cup muffin tin with cooking spray.
Whisk the eggs, egg whites and black pepper together.
Divide the spinach, red bell pepper, turkey sausage and cheddar cheese among the cups.
Pour the egg mixture over the top and bake 20-22 minutes until set.
